title: Migrate to new $gnars
subtitle: One home for $gnars on Clanker. Sell your scattered Zora coins to ETH, deposit the ETH into the migration, and claim your new $gnars after launch. ETH is the only way in.
connectPrompt: Connect your wallet to see your Zora coins and enter the migration.

guide.title: How the migration works
guide.intro: This is a shared entry into the new token, not a public swap tool. Everyone deposits ETH; at launch every deposit goes into one batch buy, and everyone gets in at the same price. ETH is the only asset the contract accepts — old $gnars, ZORA and USDC are rejected on-chain.

steps.title: Turn Zora coins into ETH
steps.body: Batch-select your scattered Zora content and creator coins. Each one is sold straight to ETH in a single trade; thin pools move the price, and the estimate you see already reflects that. Already hold old $gnars? It has to be sold to ETH too — or simply held. Both are legitimate choices.

steps.title: Deposit ETH into the migration
steps.body: Your ETH goes into the UpgraderEth contract under your own address. You can withdraw it at any time until the operator runs the launch. No close date has been announced, so the window can end without notice.

steps.title: One batch buy at launch (TGE)
steps.body: In a single transaction the operator uses every deposit to buy the new $gnars, deployed on Clanker and paired with ETH. Everyone enters at the same price.

steps.title: Claim your new $gnars
steps.body: After the batch runs, claim your new $gnars here — allocated pro-rata to what you deposited. That's the token going forward: ETH ↔ $gnars ↔ content coins.

guide.footnote: Launch terms are set by the operator (Onchain Inc / kompreni) and are not readable from the contract, so we don't show them here — they will be published in the launch announcement. Estimates depend on live liquidity and can change; always verify links in official Gnars channels.

holdingsError: Couldn't load your Zora coins. Nothing is assumed — try again.
safetyHint: Only verified Zora coins are shown — non-Zora and scam/airdrop tokens are filtered out.

route.title: Sell route
route.hopHint: Each coin routes through its pool pairing into ETH. One trade per coin — these are the hops under the hood.

preview.title: Sell preview
preview.slippageNote: Thin pools move the price on large sells — the estimate already includes up to 5% slippage and can change before the transaction confirms.
preview.leftoverNote: The deposit uses the guaranteed minimum from the quote. Anything received above it stays in your wallet as ETH — you can deposit it from the terminal below.
preview.consolidateOnly: Sell to ETH only — keep it in my wallet
preview.batchNote: One signature: every sell and the deposit run as a single sponsored transaction.
preview.sequentialNote: Your wallet will ask for {count} signatures, one per step, and you pay the gas.

deposit.title: Migration deposit
deposit.gatedHint: The deposit terminal turns on here once the contract and upgrade id are confirmed. Sell to ETH now if you want to be ready — the ETH stays in your wallet until then.
deposit.configError: The deposit terminal is misconfigured and has been disabled: {error}
deposit.readError: Couldn't read your deposit from the contract. Nothing is assumed — your deposit is not shown as zero.
deposit.closeValue: No notice given — can end at any time
how: Your ETH is held in the UpgraderEth contract under your address. You can withdraw it until the operator runs the launch.
At launch (TGE) every deposit goes into one batch buy of the new $gnars at a single shared price.
You claim your new $gnars here, pro-rata to your share of the deposits.
deposit.withdrawHint: Withdraw returns ETH to this same address. It works until the operator runs the launch, and not after.
deposit.ownerNote: The contract is operated by Onchain Inc (kompreni), not by the Gnars DAO. Its owner can halt deposits and move tokens out of the contract. Withdraw is the exit you control.

editorial.body: Fragmented Zora dust becomes ETH, and ETH becomes one deep, ETH-paired $gnars on Clanker — with everyone entering at the same price through the migration.

oldGnars.title: Your old $gnars
oldGnars.body: The contract does not accept old $gnars. To enter with it, it has to be sold to ETH first — through the thin $gnars → ZORA → WETH pool, at the price below.
oldGnars.impactHint: Price impact is how much worse the price of selling everything is compared with selling a small amount — the cost of this sale's size, not a warning about something else. Selling is not free.
oldGnars.include: Sell my old $gnars to ETH along with the coins above
oldGnars.includeHint: Adds it to the sell preview below. It is quoted and sold like any other coin.
oldGnars.holdTitle: Or hold it and do nothing
oldGnars.holdBody: A legitimate choice. Old $gnars stays a tradable Zora creator coin; it just does not enter the migration.
oldGnars.balanceError: Couldn't read your old $gnars balance. Nothing is assumed — try again.
